markets.name: Auchan
markets.note: anchor; recon 2026-07-02: plain requests GET https://zakupy.auchan.pl/ = 200 (real SPA shell, no CDN/WAF block). Driving that shell's own homepage load — even via plain requests, no Playwright required — hits the unauthenticated GET https://zakupy.auchan.pl/api/webproductpagews/v5/product-pages?decoratedOnly=true&limit=N&tag=web&tag=lohp endpoint, which returns real curated 'featured'/'on_offer'/'group' product listings (name/brand/price/promoPrice/packSizeDescription/catchweight/categoryPath/image) — genuine live data, not a full category crawl (the SPA's per-category /api/webproductpagews/v6/products endpoint requires a CSRF token + session-bound client-route-id minted by the SPA, out of scope for the recon budget). Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/auchan_pl_sample.json). category_deny_prefixes added 2026-07-11 (task 20): unlike Lidl PL, Auchan is a real hypermarket where most of the 24,034-product full-catalog crawl (task 19) genuinely is grocery, so a deny-list of the few non-grocery departments is safer than an allow-list. Inspected the full department taxonomy + real product names (not just labels) and found 3 of 11 top-level departments are, wholly or overwhelmingly, durable general merchandise: 'Auto-Moto' (120 products, 100% car care), 'Artykuły biurowe i szkolne' (238 products, 100% office/school supplies), and 'Artykuły dla domu' (765 products — kitchenware/furniture/lighting/garden/computer+GSM accessories/DIY/sport equipment; a small food-adjacent minority, e.g. protein bars under its 'Sport' subtree, is an acceptable loss vs. importing furniture as groceries). Within the otherwise-kept 'Dziecko i Mama' (baby food/diapers/wipes/toiletries/laundry detergent/postpartum care), the 'Zabawki' (toys) subtree is denied — LEGO alone is 184 products, the single largest leaf category in the whole catalog. This required changing raw_category (see auchan_pl.py's Phase 3 docstring) from the deepest categoryPath segment to the full '/'-joined breadcrumb, since a bare leaf name is legitimately reused across departments (e.g. 'Pieczenie' = deli pate under Artykuły spożywcze OR bakeware under Artykuły dla domu) and only the full per-product breadcrumb disambiguates which one a product is. Verified against the task-19 dump (re-derived full paths via the separately-captured category taxonomy tree, see task-20 report): kept 22,531/24,034 (93.7%), 91.1% of kept products resolve to a canonical category_map.json slug.

markets.name: Biedronka
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: the corporate/leaflet site www.biedronka.pl/pl is gazetka-only (no catalog), BUT Biedronka also runs a genuine e-commerce storefront at https://zakupy.biedronka.pl/ (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware) — plain `requests` GET of both the homepage and category pages (e.g. /nabial/mleko/) = 200, real server-rendered product tiles, no Cloudflare/WAF, no Playwright needed. Each tile embeds a `data-product-gtm="{...}"` JSON attribute (GA4 ecommerce tracking) with clean name/id/price/brand/category fields — cleaner than parsing the visual price markup. No EAN/GTIN present anywhere (checked tile markup + a live PDP fetch) -> barcode left None. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/biedronka_sample.html, /nabial/mleko/, 10 real dairy products, 0 barcodes).

markets.name: Lidl
category_allow_prefixes: Światy potrzeb/Żywność i żywność w pobliżu/
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: www.lidl.pl/ and its CMS category hub pages (e.g. /c/zywnosc-i-napoje/s10068374) are Nuxt-SSR content/teaser pages with no product grid (confirmed via Playwright too — no product/price XHR fired). BUT https://www.lidl.pl/q/search?q=<term> IS server-rendered with a genuine embedded Nuxt `__NUXT_DATA__` payload containing real current leaflet/shelf prices (title/brand/price/oldPrice/packaging/category/image), reachable via plain `requests`, no Playwright needed. EAN/GTIN exists in this payload ONLY on Lidl's general/durable-goods (NonFood) items, never on Food items -> barcode left None for groceries. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/lidl_pl_sample.json, /q/search?q=mleko, 11 real products across Food+NonFood, 0 barcodes). category_allow_prefixes added 2026-07-11 (task 18): the full-catalog crawl (6,308 products, 1,043 distinct raw_category breadcrumbs, see task-17 report) surfaced that Lidl PL's online search/category API is overwhelmingly a general-merchandise online shop (Moda/clothing 1,998; Dom & Urządzanie/furniture 1,216; Warsztat/tools 1,011; Sport i wypoczynek 458; Zdrowie & uroda 88 — all durable beauty appliances, not consumable toiletries; Świat zwierząt 48 — durable pet gear, zero pet food) that must never reach a grocery app. Only 3 breadcrumb branches were verified (by inspecting actual product names, not just label text) to be genuine food/household-consumables: literal 'Food' (4 products), the 13-leaf 'Światy potrzeb/Żywność i żywność w pobliżu/' subtree (48 products: ready meals, cold cuts, pork, ice cream, frozen fish, oil, fruit, veg, cheese, savory snacks, dried fruit/nuts, rice/pasta/legumes), and 'Kategorie/Produkty spożywcze i środki czystości/' (2 products: Lupilu baby diapers + a mislabeled baby bodysuit). Alcohol ('Światy potrzeb/Wino, piwo i napoje spirytusowe/', 27 products) and all durable pet/beauty/kitchen-appliance branches were deliberately left OUT of the allow list — no canonical Cheep category fits them and several are mixed alcoholic/non-alcoholic. Net effect: ~54 of 6,308 products pass the domain filter; the rest is Lidl's durable-goods catalog, out of scope for a grocery price app.

markets.name: Żabka
markets.note: convenience; recon 2026-07-02: the delivery app site https://jush.pl/ is a plain WordPress marketing landing page for the mobile app (no __NEXT_DATA__/__NUXT__/inline bundle at all) with no reachable catalog (jush.pl/sklep, app.jush.pl, sklep.jush.pl, api.jush.pl all 404/unreachable) — the real Jush delivery catalog is app-only. BUT https://www.zabka.pl/ (also 200, plain requests, no Playwright) embeds a real 'this week's offers' Gutenberg product carousel directly on the homepage with genuine names/package sizes and (for ~half the tiles) an explicit current zł price via the EU Omnibus 'lowest price in 30 days' label. Curated, not a full catalog (~16 tiles, no pagination/search endpoint found); no EAN or separate brand field -> both left None. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/zabka_sample.html, 8 real products with unambiguous single-value prices, 0 barcodes).
